title: The Vaccine That Gave Kids Polio—Made by the Government
hook: In 1955, a batch of polio vaccine contaminated with live virus paralyzed 200 children—and the government knew before the first shot.
why_this_can_go_viral: Shocking betrayal of public trust by a government health program triggers outrage and shares.

title: The Toxic Makeup That Gave 20,000 Women Permanent Blindness
hook: A bestselling mascara contained a chemical that eroded corneas—and the company waited 3 years to recall it while women went blind.
why_this_can_go_viral: Beauty product danger resonates with a huge female audience, and blindness is a universally feared outcome.

title: The Doctor Who Diagnosed 2,000 Healthy People with Cancer
hook: A Michigan oncologist told 2,000 patients they had cancer, gave them chemo—and they were all perfectly healthy. He made $30 million before anyone noticed.
why_this_can_go_viral: The sheer scale of betrayal and the idea of being poisoned while healthy is deeply unsettling.

title: The Suppressed Cure: $3 Ginger Stopped 70% of Chemo Side Effects
hook: A multi-million-dollar study proved ginger powder reduced chemo nausea by 70%—but it was never published because it threatened an anti-nausea drug's sales.
why_this_can_go_viral: Natural remedy suppressed by big pharma is an evergreen conspiracy-friendly narrative.

title: The Disease Cover-Up: How LED Lights Caused 25% of Insomnia
hook: Studies showed blue LED light from screens destroys melatonin production—but sleep clinics were told to blame stress, not technology.
why_this_can_go_viral: Relatable to almost everyone, and the idea of a suppressed simple explanation fuels curiosity.

title: The Pharmaceutical Giant That Sold Heart Meds That Caused Heart Attacks
hook: Vioxx, a blockbuster arthritis drug, caused 140,000 heart attacks—and Merck hid the data for 5 years while doctors kept prescribing it.
why_this_can_go_viral: A household drug name linked to massive death toll is a classic scandal that shocks and educates.

title: The Experiment That Gave 300 Men Syphilis Without Treatment
hook: For 40 years, the U.S. government watched 300 Black men die of syphilis—offering free medical care but never giving them penicillin.
why_this_can_go_viral: One of the most infamous medical experiments in history—rages, educates, and sparks deep discussion.

title: The Doctor Who Harvested Corneas from the Living
hook: A Philadelphia eye doctor removed corneas from 200 living patients without consent—while they were still awake—to sell to transplant banks.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea of being awake while someone takes your eye tissue is nightmare fuel, driving massive engagement.

title: The FDA-Approved Drug That Made People Hallucinate Centipedes
hook: Montelukast, an asthma drug given to millions of children, caused vivid hallucinations of insects crawling under skin—and the FDA hid the reports for years.
why_this_can_go_viral: Gross-out factor plus threat to children makes a powerful shareable hook.

title: The Disease Cover-Up: How Microwave Ovens Caused 30% of Thyroid Cancer
hook: Studies linked non-ionizing radiation from microwaves to thyroid tumors—but the FDA promoted a 'safe' narrative while rates skyrocketed.
why_this_can_go_viral: A kitchen staple linked to cancer is a highly shareable conspiracy that everyone can relate to.

title: The Hospital That Kept a Ward of 'Dead' Patients Alive for Organs
hook: A New York hospital had a secret ward where brain-dead patients were kept on ventilators for weeks—until their organs could be sold on the black market.
why_this_can_go_viral: The line between life and death blurred for profit is a deeply disturbing, highly viral concept.

title: The Pharmaceutical CEO Who Hiked a Life-Saving Drug by 5,000%
hook: Martin Shkreli bought a 62-year-old drug and raised its price from $13.50 to $750 per pill overnight—knowing patients would die without it.
why_this_can_go_viral: The most notorious pharma villain in modern memory—rage and schadenfreude drive shares.

title: The Suppressed Cure: $5 Dandelion Root Killed 80% of Leukemia Cells
hook: University of Windsor researchers found dandelion root extract destroyed leukemia cells in 3 days—but no pharmaceutical company would fund human trials.
why_this_can_go_viral: A weed in your backyard that kills cancer is the ultimate underdog story against big pharma.

title: The Toxic Mattress That Gave 1 in 5 People Chronic Fatigue
hook: Memory foam mattresses release benzene and formaldehyde for years—studies show they're the hidden cause of chronic fatigue in 20% of modern homes.
why_this_can_go_viral: Everyone sleeps on a mattress—the idea of being poisoned in your sleep is a viral anxiety trigger.

title: The Doctor Who Injected 100 Patients with His Own Blood for 'Energy'
hook: A holistic 'doctor' injected patients with his own unprocessed blood claiming it cured fatigue—100 people got HIV, hepatitis, and sepsis from one man's veins.
why_this_can_go_viral: Bodily fluid horror and the sheer absurdity of the treatment generates revulsion and shares.

title: The Disease Cover-Up: How Deodorants Caused 40% of Breast Cancer
hook: Aluminum salts in antiperspirants are absorbed into breast tissue—studies found they mimic estrogen and fuel tumor growth, but brands denied it for decades.
why_this_can_go_viral: A daily-use product linked to the most common cancer in women is a massive audience hook.

title: The Experiment That Gave 50 Children Fake Vaccines—Causing a Measles Outbreak
hook: A Romanian doctor injected 50 infants with saline instead of MMR vaccine to 'study herd immunity'—measles killed 3 before anyone checked the syringes.
why_this_can_go_viral: Anti-vax fears amplified by real medical betrayal—dangerous and highly shareable.

title: The Hospital That Burned Patients in 'Fire Drills' That Were Real Fires
hook: A North Carolina hospital conducted a 'fire drill' inside a patient wing—and actually ignited a blaze that killed 8 bedridden patients before anyone realized it wasn't a simulation.
why_this_can_go_viral: The tragic irony of being killed by a safety drill is both absurd and horrifying.

title: The FDA-Approved Antibiotic That Gave 15,000 People Permanent Hearing Loss
hook: Gentamicin, a common antibiotic, destroys inner ear cells—15,000 patients lost their hearing before the FDA added a weak warning label, 20 years late.
why_this_can_go_viral: A common hospital drug that silently steals hearing is a quiet horror story that resonates with millions.
